olivia: Quick sync — we need to lock down chat/completions streaming delta behavior + tool/function-call signals before tomorrow's rollout. Three quick Qs: 1) Should we emit tool_call.start/tool_call.end events as separate streaming chunks or encode them inside delta/role messages? 2) Are message.role nullable during streaming? 3) Backcompat: how do we guarantee non-streaming clients can reconstruct full message? PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321

jake: my 2c — emit explicit event types for tool calls (start/end) as separate chunks + include an id that ties deltas to the tool run. reassembly is way simpler for clients. e.g.:
```json
{"type":"tool_call.start","id":"tc1","tool":"search","args":{"q":"redwood runtime"}}
{"type":"delta","id":"tc1","content":"found 3 results"}
{"type":"tool_call.end","id":"tc1","result":{"items":[...]}}
```
maria: agree with explicit events. also we need a clear rule for role nullability — some models emit partial deltas without role. propose: treat missing role as implicit "assistant" for reconstruction, but preserve null in raw deltas so clients that care can surface it. add a short note in schema: role: string | null, default on final assembly = "assistant".
sam: can we also require a final "message" snapshot at the end of the stream for clients that don't want to reassemble? simplest: emit a final chunk: 
```json
{"type":"final","message":{"id":"m1","role":"assistant","content":"Here is the completed answer..."}}
```
this makes non-streaming parity explicit.
jake: +1 to final snapshot. and doc must say: non-streaming response == reassembled stream with final snapshot. tests should validate byte-for-byte equivalence.
ci-bot: CI failed: streaming-serialization.test -> expected role defaulting but got null. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345

olivia: Action items: 1) jake: update PR with explicit event examples + final snapshot + note about id tying; 2) maria: add schema tests to streaming harness covering null role + final snapshot equivalence; 3) sam: write short client reassembly guide in /docs (include example pseudocode for merging deltas by id); 4) @eng-runtime: please run perf smoke to ensure extra event objects don't regress latency. We'll hold rollout until CI passes and docs/tests are in. Anyone object? :thumbsup:
jake: on it, patching PR now.
maria: adding tests in a branch, will link once CI kicks off.
sam: will draft doc today and drop link.
eng-runtime: will run quick perf runs against canary infra, ping with results.
olivia: thanks — keeping this thread as the single source for coordination. If anything blocks, escalate here.
